unlisted_practices: Prespecify the embodied or relational mechanism expected to change and pair it with at least one relevant process measure and a clinical or functional outcome when evaluating AI-mediated psychotherapy.
Examine longer-term effects of AI-mediated psychotherapy across broader dimensions of well-being.

Calibrate multisensory and embodied features of AI-mediated psychotherapy by experimentally identifying the minimum embodied affordances needed to produce a meaningful incremental effect on a specified therapeutic mechanism.
Match governance and clinical oversight of AI-mediated psychotherapy to the system's access to physiological and sensory data, degree of simulated responsiveness, and autonomy.
Incorporate data minimization and transparent disclosure of data management in AI-mediated psychotherapy interventions.
Involve interdisciplinary expertise in establishing consent, data minimization, disclosure, oversight, and escalation pathways for AI-mediated psychotherapy.
Systematically assess adverse psychological and relational effects of AI-mediated psychotherapy.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual/perspective paper proposing an agenda and framework for embodied, multisensory features and responsible governance in AI-mediated psychotherapy.
